# v1.2.1 — Rate limit handling & full API coverage

The first release since 1.1.3. It includes everything listed under 1.2.0 in the
[changelog](https://github.com/firefliesai/fireflies-node-sdk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md),
which was never published on its own.

## Highlights

### 🚦 Rate limit handling
Rate-limited requests (HTTP 429 or a `too_many_requests` GraphQL error) are retried
after the wait the API asks for, up to `maxRetryWaitMs` (65 s by default). Longer
waits fail straight away with a `FirefliesRateLimitError` carrying `retryAfter` and
`retryAt`. `batchProcess` paces batches from the rate-limit headers, and
`sdk.rateLimit` exposes the current state.
→ [Limits per plan](https://docs.fireflies.ai/fundamentals/limits)

### ✨ Full API coverage
24 new typed methods cover the rest of the public GraphQL API: meeting management
and sharing, direct upload, live meeting controls, AskFred, channels, contacts,
user groups, analytics, audit events and rule executions.

## Fixes

- `createBite` sends `transcript_id`, the argument name the API documents, and
  declares `privacies` as `[BitePrivacy!]`.
- `addToLiveMeeting` declares `attendees` as `[AttendeeInput!]`.
- `getTranscripts` declares every filter it sends (`fromDate`, `toDate`,
  `organizers`, `participants`, `scope`, …) with the schema's exact types.
- `getAskFredThread` no longer selects the removed `error` field.
- A GraphQL response with `errors` and no `data` now throws instead of returning `undefined`.
